title: More invisible item frames
body:
Version Compatibility: Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21.11 and older versions.

Mod Support: Optimized for the [More (Item/Painting) Frame Variants (MStV+)](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-frame-variants) mod, ensuring that all additional frame types can also benefit from the invisibility effect.

Intended Use: Perfect for decorative displays, interior designs, and achieving a cleaner look for your storage rooms.
